title: Planning a Picnic
description: Four recordings about planning a picnic: friends making plans, a weather forecast, a shopping call and a message about changes.
instructions: Read the questions for each part first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer (A, B or C) for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · Making plans
parts.intro: You will hear two friends, Nam and Emma, planning a picnic.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Hi, Nam! I want to have a picnic on Sunday. Are you free?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: I think so. I have football in the morning, but I finish at twelve. Where do you want to go?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: I was thinking about the lake in Green Park. It's quiet, and there are lots of trees.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Good idea. But it's far from my house. Can we go by bike?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: I'd prefer to go by bus. My bike has a flat tyre, and the bus stop is right outside the park.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: OK. Who else is coming?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Linh and her little brother, and maybe Tom. That makes five people, or six if Tom comes.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: That's a nice number. Shall I bring some games?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Yes, please. Bring your frisbee. I'll bring a big blanket to sit on.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Perfect. Let's meet at the bus stop at one o'clock.

parts.title: Part 2 · The weather forecast
parts.intro: You will hear a radio weather forecast for the weekend.

script.speaker: Presenter
script.text: Here is the weather forecast for the weekend. On Saturday, expect heavy rain in most parts of the country, with strong winds in the north.

script.speaker: Presenter
script.text: Sunday will be much better. The morning will be cloudy and a little cold, but in the afternoon the clouds will go away.

script.speaker: Presenter
script.text: By two o'clock, it will be sunny and warm, about twenty degrees. It will be a perfect day to be outside.

script.speaker: Presenter
script.text: However, the evening will be cooler, so take a jumper if you stay out late.

script.speaker: Presenter
script.text: Next week will start dry, but we expect rain again on Wednesday. That is all for now. Have a lovely weekend!

parts.title: Part 3 · Planning the food
parts.intro: You will hear Emma on the phone with her father, asking about food for the picnic.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Dad, can I ask you something? I need food for the picnic on Sunday.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: Of course, Emma. What do you have in mind?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Sandwiches, I think. Cheese and tomato. And some fruit, like apples and grapes.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: That sounds nice. But don't forget something sweet. I can make a chocolate cake tonight, if you like.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: That would be great! Oh, but my friend Linh can't eat nuts. Is there any in the cake?

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: No, there aren't any. I'll make it simple. What about drinks?

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Orange juice and water. Last time, we took lemonade, but it was too sweet.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: OK. I'll put the juice in a cold bag, so it stays cool. And take a bag for rubbish, too.

script.speaker: Emma
script.text: Good idea, Dad. We must leave the park clean.

script.speaker: Dad
script.text: That's the spirit. I'm proud of you. Have a lovely time!

parts.title: Part 4 · A change of plan
parts.intro: You will hear a voicemail from Nam to Emma.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Hi, Emma. It's Nam. Sorry to bother you, but I have some news about Sunday.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: First, I can't come to the picnic at one o'clock. Our football match is later than usual, so I'll finish at two. Can you wait for me? I'll take a taxi, and I'll be at the lake by half past two.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Second, Tom can come after all. He says he'll bring a guitar and some songs. I think that will be fun.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: And third, I checked the bus. The bus on Sunday only goes every hour, so please be careful about the time.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Call me back if the plan is a problem. Otherwise, see you at the lake. Bye!
